metadata.name: vello_escrow
metadata.description: Vello Protocol escrow for campaign treasury

instructions.name: cancel_campaign
docs: Cancel an active campaign and refund the ACTUAL vault balance to the
creator. No approved_count gate. Halts future accruals via status.

instructions.name: claim_payout
docs: Pay the newly-owed delta for one clip, capped to the remaining budget,
skimming the protocol fee. Checked-effects-interactions: accounting is
bumped BEFORE the PDA-signed CPI transfers, so a retry/concurrent crank
pays exactly zero the second time. Idempotent no-op when nothing is owed.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless crank — pays the gas, gains nothing. Funds can only flow
to the claim's recorded beneficiary ATA + the configured treasury.

accounts.name: beneficiary_usdc_ata
docs: Beneficiary's USDC ATA — must be the wallet recorded by the oracle.
init_if_needed so a never-before-paid clipper can be paid in one crank.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_ata
docs: Protocol-fee sink — must be owned by PlatformConfig.treasury.

instructions.name: create_campaign
docs: Create a per-campaign vault. Transfers `initial_budget` USDC from the
creator's ATA into the PDA-owned escrow ATA. reserved starts at 0.

instructions.name: init_platform_config
docs: Initialize the global platform config (called once at deploy time).
`authority` (the signer) becomes the admin / sweep authority.
`oracle` is the only signer allowed to call record_performance / reject_clip.

instructions.name: record_performance
docs: Record the oracle's cumulative verified views for one (campaign, submission).
Idempotent + monotonic: verified_views must never decrease. Accrual is
floor(verified_views * rate_per_1k / 1000) using a u128 intermediate.
Does NOT transfer any tokens — disbursement is the separate claim_payout.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: The oracle key pinned in PlatformConfig.oracle — must sign.

instructions.name: refund_remaining
docs: Sweep the remaining vault balance back to the creator after the deadline
(or once Closed/Cancelled). Sweeps the ACTUAL ATA balance (unspent budget
+ rounding dust). Sets status = Closed.

instructions.name: register_agent_wallet
docs: Register an AgentWallet PDA for a newly minted Vello agent.
Called once per agent mint (off-chain, via the /api/nft/mint route).

accounts.name: agent_usdc_ata
docs: ATA owned by the agent_wallet PDA — receives USDC campaign payouts

instructions.name: reject_clip
docs: Freeze a clip (fraud / ineligible). Oracle- or authority-gated.
A frozen ClaimRecord can never be paid or re-recorded.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Either the oracle key or the admin authority (checked above).

instructions.name: sweep_to_treasury
docs: Sweep accumulated USDC from the agent's on-chain ATA to the Vello treasury.
Only the configured platform authority may call this, and funds can only
move to the treasury account recorded in PlatformConfig.
Used for the hybrid settlement model: on-chain USDC sweeps replenish compute credits.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Vello platform authority — must match PlatformConfig.authority and sign sweeps

instructions.name: top_up
docs: Add more USDC to an existing campaign vault. Permissionless funder.
budget += amount (checked). Sound, kept from the original program.

instructions.name: update_campaign_rate
docs: Change the per-1,000-view USDC payout rate for FUTURE view growth.
PROSPECTIVE ONLY: bumping `rate_epoch` makes each clip's next
record_performance settle its accrued-at-old-rate into a baseline BEFORE
applying the new rate, so already-attested views keep their old price
(Appendix B.1 — the retroactive-repricing trap the audit must enforce).
Creator-only; emits CampaignRateChanged for the off-chain audit log. Has no
effect on accrued/paid until the next attestation, so a rate change can
never claw back owed-unpaid and never reprices already-counted views.

instructions.name: update_platform_config
docs: Rotate any of the config fields. Admin-only.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Campaign deadline must be in the future

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury account does not match the configured platform treasury

errors.name: InvalidFeeBps
errors.msg: Protocol fee bps exceeds the maximum allowed

errors.name: InvalidWindowConfig
errors.msg: dispute_window_slots must be strictly less than max_staleness_slots

errors.name: CampaignExpired
errors.msg: Campaign deadline has passed; no new accrual

errors.name: CampaignStillActive
errors.msg: Campaign is still active (deadline not reached and not closed)

errors.name: RefundGraceActive
errors.msg: Refund grace window after the deadline has not yet elapsed

errors.name: NonMonotonicViews
errors.msg: Verified views must be monotonically non-decreasing

errors.name: ClipFrozen
errors.msg: This clip has been frozen and cannot be paid

errors.name: InDisputeWindow
errors.msg: Attestation is still inside the dispute window

errors.name: AttestationStale
errors.msg: Attestation is too stale to claim against

errors.name: BeneficiaryMismatch
errors.msg: Beneficiary account does not match the recorded claim beneficiary

errors.name: ClaimCampaignMismatch
errors.msg: Claim record does not belong to this campaign

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that minted this agent (the "owner" in Vello terms)

fields.name: session_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the sessionId — uniquely identifies the agent mint

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint this wallet holds

fields.name: creator
docs: Brand/owner; only key that may refund/cancel (has_one).

fields.name: campaign_id
docs: Convex campaigns._id mirror key.

fields.name: rate_per_1k
docs: USDC base units (6 dp) per 1,000 verified views.

fields.name: budget
docs: Total funds committed (deposited), base units.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Total already paid out, base units. Invariant: reserved <= budget.

fields.name: total_verified_views
docs: Running sum of verified views across clips (analytics).

fields.name: deadline_unix
docs: Unix secs; refund/cancel allowed at/after this.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 Active | 1 Cancelled | 2 Closed.

fields.name: rate_epoch
docs: Bumped by update_campaign_rate. A claim whose rate_epoch lags the campaign's
is settled (accrued frozen into a baseline) on its next record_performance,
so a rate change is PROSPECTIVE — old views are never repriced (Appendix B.1).

fields.name: padding
docs: Forward-compat padding. NAMED `padding`, not `_reserved`: a leading-underscore
field camelCases to `reserved` in the generated IDL/JS client and would SHADOW
the real `reserved` u64 — a client reading `campaign.reserved` would get this
byte array instead of the paid-out accumulator. (Caught by anchor test.)

fields.name: submission_id
docs: Convex submissions._id mirror key (one per (campaign, agent)).

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Agent payout wallet (AgentWallet PDA or raw wallet).

fields.name: verified_views
docs: Oracle-attested cumulative views — monotonic high-water mark.

fields.name: accrued
docs: floor(verified_views * rate_per_1k / 1000), pre-cap.

fields.name: paid
docs: Amount already transferred for this clip. paid <= accrued always.

fields.name: last_recorded_slot
docs: Chain slot of the latest accepted record — STALENESS basis (advances on
every accepted record, incl. dips + equal-views keep-alives).

fields.name: last_accrual_slot
docs: Chain slot at which `accrued` last INCREASED — the DISPUTE-window basis.
Kept separate from last_recorded_slot so a keep-alive/dip re-record (which
only refreshes staleness) can't re-arm the dispute window and perpetually
block a payout for an already-earned delta (finding #3).

fields.name: frozen
docs: Set by reject_clip; halts all future records + claims.

fields.name: last_attest_tx
docs: Oracle attestation tx sig (audit).

fields.name: score_hash
docs: Oracle evidence hash (audit, not verified on-chain).

fields.name: rate_epoch
docs: Campaign rate_epoch this claim's baseline is settled to. When it lags the
campaign's, record_performance settles before accruing (prospective rate).

fields.name: accrued_baseline
docs: Accrued amount locked in at prior rate epochs (the old-rate portion).

fields.name: views_baseline
docs: verified_views already priced into accrued_baseline; only views ABOVE this
price at the current rate. Re-based on every rate change.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin key — the only signer allowed to sweep agent wallets / rotate config.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the treasury ATA that sweeps + protocol fees must land in.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The only signer allowed to record_performance / reject_clip.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee skimmed on each claim_payout, in basis points (500 = 5%). 0 disables.

fields.name: dispute_window_slots
docs: A fresh attestation delta is not claimable until this many slots elapse.

fields.name: max_staleness_slots
docs: claim_payout is blocked if the attestation is older than this many slots.
